caseNameFull: Newlin Haines Company v. Edward E. Grosscup, Trustee, etc.

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied. Mr. Edward L. Katzenbach and Mr. D. Howard Evans for petitioner. Mr. Nathan Büder and Mr. David H. Bilder for respondent.
